default: # Antigravity Token Tracker > Track and visualize token consumption (**Input**, **Output**, **Cache Read**) for every [Antigravity](https://antigravity.google/) task and conversation. [English](#english) | [中文](#中文) --- ## Screenshots ### Sidecar Analytics Panel ![Token Tracker Side Panel](./assets/screenshot-panel.png) ### Plugin Overview & Quick Entry ![Antigravity Plugin Overview](./assets/screenshot-plugin.png) ![Extensions Menu Entry](./assets/screenshot-extensions.png) ## Features - **Per-Turn Summary Hook (`PostInvocation`)**: Automatically appends a concise token usage summary (`Total`, `Input`, `Output`, `Cache Read`, and session total) after each turn, with a one-click link to open the side panel. - **Sidecar Web UI Panel**: - **Current Task View**: Inspect total, input, output, and cache read tokens for the active conversation, along with a per-turn breakdown and planning/execution call counts. - **All Tasks View**: Aggregate token consumption across all local conversations with 7-day daily / 24-hour hourly trend charts, keyword search, and sorting (by recent activity, total tokens, or non-cached tokens). - **Subagent & Swarm Aggregation**: Automatically detects and rolls up token usage from spawned subagents and swarm members into their parent task. - **Configurable Hook Summary**: Toggle whether to show the cumulative session total directly from the panel settings. - **Built-in Skill**: Ask Antigravity in natural language to summarize token usage for the current or past conversations, or to open the Token Tracker side panel. ## Directory Structure ```text token-tracker/ ├── plugin.json # Plugin metadata & suggested prompts ├── hooks.json # PostInvocation hook configuration ├── assets/ │ └── logo.svg # Plugin icon ├── hooks/ │ └── report-tokens.mjs # Hook script that prints per-turn token summaries ├── lib/ │ └── tokens.mjs # transcript.jsonl parser, subagent aggregation & time-series stats ├── sidecars/ │ └── token_panel/ # Sidecar Web UI │ ├── sidecar.json │ ├── package.json │ ├── main.mjs │ ├── index.html │ ├── app.js │ └── styles.css └── skills/ └── token-tracker/ └── SKILL.md # Agent skill instructions ``` ## Installation Clone this repository into Antigravity's plugin directory `~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-tracker`: ```bash git clone https://github.com/Willian-Wu/Antigravity-Token-Tracker.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-tracker ``` Make sure **Node.js 18+** (with ES Module support) is installed, then enable `token-tracker` in Antigravity. ## Data & Privacy - Reads only local transcript files under `~/.gemini/antigravity/brain//.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl` (as well as `ANTIGRAVITY_APP_DATA`, `antigravity-ide`, and `antigravity-cli` directories if present). - All parsing and visualization run 100% locally — no data is sent to external servers. - Panel preferences are saved locally in `settings.json` (git-ignored). --- ## 中文文档 一个用于 [Antigravity](https://antigravity.google/) 的轻量级插件，用于统计、追踪并可视化每个任务与会话的 Token 消耗（Input、Output、Cache Read）。 ### 功能特性 - **每轮自动摘要（PostInvocation Hook）**：每次对话轮次结束后，自动在聊天中展示本轮 Token 消耗（Total / In / Out / Cache）以及当前会话累计消耗，并附带一键打开详情面板的链接。 - **侧边栏可视化面板（Sidecar Web UI）**： - **当前任务视图**：查看当前会话的总计、输入、输出、缓存命中统计，以及按轮次（Turn）拆分的明细和规划/执行阶段次数。 - **全部任务视图**：汇总所有历史会话的 Token 消耗，支持 7 天按日 / 24 小时按小时趋势图、关键词搜索以及按最近更新 / 总 Token / 非缓存 Token 排序。 - **子代理与 Swarm 聚合**：自动识别并合并当前任务派生出的 Subagent 与 Swarm 成员的 Token 消耗。 - **Hook 摘要设置**：支持在面板右上角开关「显示本会话累计」。 - **内置 Skill**：支持通过自然语言直接让 Agent 汇总当前会话或历史任务的 Token 消耗，或唤起 Token Tracker 侧边栏面板。 ### 安装方式 将本仓库克隆到 Antigravity 的插件目录 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-tracker`： ```bash git clone https://github.com/Willian-Wu/Antigravity-Token-Tracker.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-tracker ``` 确保系统已安装 Node.js（支持 ES Module，建议 Node 18+），然后在 Antigravity 中启用 `token-tracker` 插件即可。 ### 数据来源与隐私 - 插件仅读取本地 `~/.gemini/antigravity/brain//.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl`（以及 `ANTIGRAVITY_APP_DATA` 环境变量指定目录、`antigravity-ide`、`antigravity-cli` 目录下的对应文件）。 - 所有统计与可视化均在本地完成，不会向任何外部服务器发送数据。 - 用户在面板中修改的配置会保存在插件根目录的 `settings.json` 中（已加入 `.gitignore`，不会提交到仓库）。 ## License [MIT](./LICENSE)
